snippet.title: ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE | Developer Diary
snippet.description:
The PROJECT ACES developers are pushing the ACE COMBAT series higher than ever. Strap in and discover an exclusive behind-the-scenes look at the development of ACE COMBAT 8.

ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE is coming to PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam in 2026.
Wishlist now: https://acecombat.com/
